records.source: A fringed brown vest over a sleeveless shirt.
records.translation: Isang kayumangging tsalekong may palawit sa ibabaw ng kamisetang walang manggas.

records.source: It's got an indistinguishable glob pattern.
It's dyed a deep midnight blue from squid ink.
records.translation: Tinina ito ng tinta ng pusit upang maging malalim na asul ng hatinggabi.

records.source: For those whose appetites demand a steady supply of shrimp.
records.translation: Para sa mga taong nangangailangan ng tuluy-tuloy na suplay ng hipon upang masiyahan ang gana.

records.source: A shirt inspired by the popular beverage.
records.translation: Isang kamisetang hango sa patok na inumin.

records.source: A shirt with large colored glass orbs attached to it.
records.translation: Isang kamisetang kinabitan ng malalaking makukulay na bolang salamin.

records.source: A black suit top with a faded red pocket square.
records.translation: Isang itim na pang-itaas na terno na may kupas na pulang panyo sa bulsa.

records.source: It's infused with trace minerals from the ocean.
records.translation: May mumunting bakas ito ng mga mineral mula sa karagatan.

records.source: This particular shade is unique to the magma cap mushroom.
records.translation: Tanging sa Kabuteng Magma matatagpuan ang partikular na kulay na ito.

records.source: The color scheme is inspired by ginger ale.
records.translation: Hango sa sodang luya ang kombinasyon ng mga kulay.

records.source: Consider this shirt, if you happen to love bananas.
records.translation: Piliin ang kamisetang ito kung talagang mahilig ka sa mga saging.

records.source: It's a bold statement to wear this suit.
records.translation: Kailangan ng tapang para isuot ang ternong ito.

records.source: A silky shirt in tropical pink.
records.translation: Isang malasutlang kamiseta sa tropikal na lilim ng kulay-rosas.
Kamiseta ng Tropikal na Pagsikat ng Araw
Isang klasikong kasuotan mula sa Kapuluan ng Fern.

records.source: It's shimmering with prismatic energy. Has dark sleeves.
records.translation: Kumikinang ito sa prismatikong enerhiya. Madilim ang mga manggas nito.

records.source: It's shimmering with prismatic energy. Has white sleeves.
records.translation: Kumikinang ito sa prismatikong enerhiya. Puti ang mga manggas nito.

records.source: Made from the leftovers of a Mystery Box.
records.translation: Yari sa mga natira mula sa isang Kahong Misteryo.
